sections.title: Situation, language and purpose
body: Goal: Use public-service information to complete listening, reading, speaking and writing tasks with separate evidence.

assignment.title: Four-skill practice, transfer and delayed return
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: answer “Who must wait until after one o'clock?” from the recording before reading the script. Save the listening result separately.

READ: answer the gist and detail questions, and mark the exact phrase that proves each answer. Save the reading result separately.

SPEAK: Call the library to book digital guidance and ask what to bring. Record an independent first attempt, then improve one feature.

WRITE: Write a short message asking for an accessible public-service appointment. Draft without the model, then revise for reader, purpose, essential detail and next action.

TRANSFER: The service is fully booked; ask about a cancellation list or another location.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: Review the weakest skill after a delay and use fresh input.
assignment.model:
SPEAKING MODEL: Hej! Jag vill boka digital rådgivning på onsdag. Finns det en tid efter klockan två? Bra, då tar jag tiden klockan halv tre. Behöver jag ta med min egen dator?

WRITING MODEL: Hej! Jag vill boka digital rådgivning nästa onsdag. Jag använder rullstol och behöver en tillgänglig arbetsplats. Finns det en tid efter klockan 14? Vänliga hälsningar, Amina

takeaways: Use: Biblioteket ordnar gratis digital rådgivning.
Register: Måste man boka före? → Måste man boka tid i förväg?
A checkpoint diagnoses what to practise next; it does not certify an exam level.
